versions.changelog:
- Shortened and clarified the skill description for broader readability.
- Added OS/Python-version compatibility info to make dependency and feature support clearer.
- Updated input format documentation for improved detail on supported ISO shapes and nanosecond handling.
- Removed the redundant file skill-card.md. 
- No functional/script changes; documentation only.

- Initial release of datetime-convert.
- Converts dates and times between multiple formats: epoch (s/ms/us/ns), ISO 8601, RFC 3339, RFC 2822, custom strftime patterns, spreadsheet serial numbers, and natural language times.
- Supports timezone shifts (e.g., UTC, Asia/Shanghai, any IANA zone), date arithmetic, and duration calculations.
- Handles bulk conversion for lists or columns of time values.
- Accepts diverse input types: timestamps, formatted date strings, relative phrases ("3 days ago", "明天"), and more.
- Outputs detailed reports or format-specific results based on user request.
